desert.architecture: Sandstone fortified oasis architecture, shaded timber balconies and flat/low clay roofs; invented medieval fantasy.

jungle.architecture: Overgrown stone citadels, timber stilt settlements and vine-worn jungle temples.

snowy.architecture: Cold fortified mountain settlements, steep slate roofs with soft snow and thick stone walls.

layerRules.props: Transparent isolated silhouette. Complete subject within central75% with generous alpha margins. No terrain platform, skyline background or ground slab. Landscape3072x1728 requested for wide city/town/mountain props; square1536 requested for compact castle/entrance.
layerRules.ground: Transparent top~52–55%; opaque lower ground extends to left/right/bottom edges. Shallow side-view plane, quiet center, peripheral detail. Landscape3072x1728 requested.
layerRules.backdrop: Opaque landscape3072x1728 requested, wide ground-level panorama with atmospheric depth and quiet middle. No foreground props or characters.
layerRules.rainVariant: Material is damp, overcast cool light; rain particles remain separate. Snowy wet street can have slush but no glossy mirror ice.
layerRules.distantMountains: Separate original prop painting with simplified forms, faded desaturated colors, soft low-contrast edges and atmospheric depth. Transparent surroundings; no opaque rectangle or fog/cloud plate. No glow.
layerRules.nightVariant: Painted cool moonlit environment, matching low-key street materials and lit town windows/lamps. Base city/castle/dungeon props may be shown with explicitly recorded preview ambient grading; that is not a painted night relight.

overscan: Source canvases must include peripheral paint/alpha room. Existing landscape/portrait/ultrawide crop checks remain necessary; requested size is not a delivered-size claim.
